name: gmail-multi-mcp
description: MCP connector for Gmail that can link and use multiple Gmail accounts at once.

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run build:worker && node --test "dist/test/*.test.js"

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Your Gmail address (several: separate them with commas). Only these Google accounts can sign in, and nobody can until this is set.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Leave empty for now. After deploying, open your Worker's address: its setup page walks you through creating a Google OAuth client, then you add its Client ID here (Settings → Variables and Secrets).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Leave empty for now. You add the Client secret of the same Google OAuth client after deploying, as the setup page explains.

OAUTH_KV.description: Storage for linked accounts and Claude's connections. Created for you.
